listing.name: MoreVanillaBounties
listing.summary: Adds More Vanilla bounties (3x more min and max) and More Vanilla bounties (Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties)

description:
Adds More Vanilla bounties (3x more min and max) and *More* Vanilla bounties (Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties)

Based on:
WasaBounties
Vayra's Sector

Errors/Bugs/Bad things:
AI cores have gender. AI cores can be built different and be level 7 gamma cores. AI cores don't drop.

**Removing this from your game bricks your save.**, can be added midsave
